name: Healer
about: Keeps the party going. Energy refills on its own. Turns enemies against each other.

E.name: Mending Vow
E.about: Put a vow on the party member nearest the mouse. When they get hit it heals them, then jumps to another party member. 1 jump, +1 per rank. Solo at full health: +20% damage for 20s instead, stacks up to 5 times.

F.name: Turn
F.about: A bolt lands on the enemy nearest the mouse and turns it to your side, then jumps and turns 2, then 3 (+1 each every 2 ranks). Turned enemies fight for you for 20s, then die. Casting again cuts the chain short. Not Bosses.
